name: Alpine Home Medical
old_description: Alpine Home Medical has been helping families across Idaho get the home medical equipment they need since 1997. For anyone searching for Idaho Falls medical supplies, our store carries one of the most thorough inventories in eastern Idaho, with everything available to purchase or rent depending on what fits your situation and your budget.
about:
Alpine Home Medical was founded in 1997 in Idaho Falls, Idaho, as a durable medical equipment retailer serving families across eastern Idaho. The company operates multiple locations in Idaho and Utah, including Idaho Falls, Logan, Ogden, and Salt Lake City.

The company stocks and rents a broad range of home medical equipment, including power reclining lift chairs, hospital beds, mobility scooters, power wheelchairs, Hoyer lifts, walkers, manual wheelchairs, bath chairs, commodes, toilet seat risers, CPAP and BiPAP machines, portable and home oxygen concentrators, cold therapy units, compression socks, and daily living aids. Its rental program offers weekly or monthly terms with simple extensions for short-term needs such as post-surgical recovery or seasonal agricultural injuries. The Idaho Falls location serves as a regional hub for patients discharged from Eastern Idaho Regional Medical Center (EIRMC) and surrounding communities.

Alpine Home Medical primarily serves individual patients, caregivers, and families in eastern Idaho and southwest Wyoming, with a focus on seniors, post-operative patients, and residents with chronic respiratory or mobility conditions. The company also works with seasonal agricultural workers needing temporary equipment and coordinates with major insurance providers including Medicare, Aetna, PEHP, Optum, and Cigna, as well as HSA and FSA cards.

The business emphasizes personalized service, with staff guiding customers through equipment selection and fitting. It differentiates itself through rural delivery across eastern Idaho — reaching farms and ranches up to 30 miles from town — and by providing equipment repair support for customers in remote areas.
